2351.unvetted: probable plaintext not checked: LXXII 192 is not a second private letter but a cipher copy of Acciaiuoli's public despatch of 23 Oct 1513. Its recto is headed in a contemporary hand 'Copia della l[ette]ra c[...]' and opens 'Mag(nifi)ci D(omi)ni etc.', the verso closes 'raccomandarmi alle Sig. V(ost)re ... Ex Amiens die xxiii Octobris MDXIII, Robertus Acciarolus', while 190 (to a single 'Mag.ce Vir', signed the same day) says in clear 'Ultra le lettere publ(iche) delle qual sara con questa el doppio'. Acciaiuoli's letter of 23 Oct 1513 to the Dieci di Balia survives at ASF, Dieci di Balia, Responsive 118, c. 139r (cited with the 20 Oct letter at c. 138r in Annuarium Historiae Conciliorum 1984, Google Books mADZAAAAMAAJ, feed snippet). If that original is in clear or carries its decipherment, 192's text is on record. Needs the Dieci Responsive 118 c. 139 (not online) or the 1984 article's text. Everything else checked: see notes.
